text:
ops-bot: :alert: SLO alert fired for streaming.generate in us-west-2 — p95 > 400ms, p99 > 1s sustained for 7m. Incident ID INC-2026-3612345678
ashley-oncall: Noticed chat streaming stalls and a handful of customer reconnects. Dashboards show tail latency spike around 09:10 UTC.
kevin-sre: I ran a replay on staging cluster; massive prefixcache misswave coincident with a namespace rehash. Hitrate on some hot shards dropped to ~6%.
marta-platform: We pushed prefix-hash change at 09:06 UTC (namespace salt bump) as part of cache cleanup rollout.
elaine-sre: Paging metrics: disk queue depth doubled, paging p99 up to 300ms. When prefix lookup misses, callers hit the disk path and streaming stalls.
kevin-sre: Logs excerpt:
```
[09:11:42] prefix_lookup key=chat:stream:user:123 status=MISS shard=kv-5
[09:11:42] paging_read start file=/data/kv/blk-5 latency=128ms
[09:11:42] stream_chunk hold=130ms tokens_delayed=3
```
ashley-oncall: Impacted customers (prelim): - OneLineChat: intermittent reconnects during streaming - MediaLive: preview frames delayed
marta-platform: Sounds like the salt change invalidated warmed prefixes. We should either rollback or enable compatibility mapping.
elaine-sre: Mitigation options: 1) Rollback prefix-hash in region 2) Enable legacy-lookup fallback 3) Trigger aggressive prefetch of recent prefixes to warm caches
kevin-sre: Rollback is quickest to reduce missrate if we can flip regionally. Fallback is safer if rollback risks other incidents.
ashley-oncall: Start rollback for us-west-2 and meanwhile run targeted warmup for top-10k prefixes. Deploy-bot, initiate.
deploy-bot: Executing rollback of prefix-hash:v3 -> v2 in us-west-2. Progress: 2/5 clusters rolled back. Estimated finish 6-9 minutes.
ops-bot: Paging IOPS trending down on rolled clusters, but remaining clusters still high. Aggregate p99 now ~850ms.
kevin-sre: Warmup job started: scanning recent 30m traffic, prefetching most frequent prefix keys. Rate-limited to avoid overloading paging subsystem.
elaine-sre: Reminder: if warmup floods disk it could worsen paging. Keep prefetch throttle at 50 concurrent reads.
marta-platform: Post-rollback plan: introduce epoched salts so lookups can check both old and new mapping for configurable overlap window. Also add a rollout check that warns on potential warm cache invalidation.
ashley-oncall: CS notified with interim note. Jen, prepare customer-facing summary: what happened, who was affected, timeframe, and remediation steps.
jen-cs: Draft ready; will send to leadership for ack before wider customer notifications.
simon-oncall: Taking handoff at 09:30 UTC. Handoff summary: prefix-hash change caused cache miss wave -> paging -> streaming tail latency. Rollback in progress, warmup running, partial mitigation seen. Continue monitoring p95/p99 and paging latencies.
kevin-sre: Early rollback effects: clusters rolled back show p95 ~ 180-210ms, p99 ~ 350-420ms. Remaining clusters still at p99 ~1.1s.
ashley-oncall: Keep alerting thresholds lowered for next 30m. If any cluster doesn't improve after rollback, escalate to infra storage team.
marta-platform: Will add a pre-deploy compatibility test and a graceful migration shim in the rollout pipeline. Also schedule a postmortem to review release gating.
elaine-sre: Post-incident action items: - full cache rebuild checklist for us-west nodes - add runbook step: if prefix-salt changes, run phased warmup or compat mode - consider short-term request-throttling to protect paging layer from storms
ashley-oncall: Severity set to Sev2 due to customer-facing degradation and SLO breach. ETA to full mitigation ~ 30m.
ops-bot: Incident status: PARTIALLY MITIGATED | p95 aggregated 195ms | p99 aggregated 410ms | monitoring ongoing
ashley-oncall: Closing immediate critical alert while we watch for regressions. Reopen if p99 > 1s or error rates increase. Final note: avoid non-backwards-compatible cache salt rotations without migration path.
-- end thread --
